body: Add ui://agb/ticket-viewer.html (buildTicketViewerHtml) and ui://agb/manifest-viewer.html (buildManifestViewerHtml) in mcp/ui-views.mjs, and register agb_ticket_viewer (surface: file, extensions: [.agbticket]) and agb_manifest_viewer (surface: file, extensions: [.agbmanifest]) in mcp/server.mjs supporting symlink-verified .adlc/tickets/*.json / .adlc/manifest.jsonl reads and antigravity-file:// deferred reads. Extend runInit in lib/doctor.mjs with automations = false (agb init --automations [--force]) to scaffold symlink-verified .agents/automations/{agb-quota-resume,agb-nightshift-distill,agb-pr-prosecutor}.json declarative Antigravity 2.0 automation definitions without overwriting user edits unless force: true. Expand test/mcp-apps.test.mjs and add test/automations-init.test.mjs. Verify: node --test test/mcp-apps.test.mjs test/automations-init.test.mjs
title: MCP App File Viewers (ticket-viewer, manifest-viewer) & agb init --automations
